title: Amir and the Jinn Princess
author: M.T. Khan
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Amir, heir to a wealthy Pakistani brick company, is devastated when his father plans to remarry, giving up the search for Amir's missing mother. Determined to find her himself, Amir teams up with Shamsa, a shape-shifting jinn princess, striking a deal to help her win a tournament of heirs in exchange for her help navigating the mysterious realm of the jinn.

title: Chaos King (Infinity Alchemist, Book 2)
author: Kacen Callender
synopsis: The explosive sequel to Infinity Alchemist. As political turmoil consumes the world around them, Ash, Ramsay, and Callum must navigate their growing powers and complicated relationship while chaos magic threatens everything they've built.

title: Chloe Vega and the Agents of Magic
author: Leslie Adame
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Chloe Vega's biggest fear is that her undocumented parents will be detained -- until she learns they're actually part of a secret magical society, and the suspicious officers watching their block are henchmen for an evil sorcerer. When her parents are kidnapped, Chloe must master her own newfound powers at a magical academy to save them.

title: Daughter of the Underworld (House of Shadows)
author: Katharine Corr, Elizabeth Corr
synopsis: Deina, an indentured Soul Severer serving the god Hades, dreams of buying her freedom. When the tyrant Orpheus offers fortune and freedom to whoever retrieves his dead wife Eurydice from the Underworld, Deina seizes the chance -- teaming up with fellow Severers she doesn't trust for a perilous journey into Hades' realm, in this feminist twist on Greek myth.

title: Impossible Creatures
author: Katherine Rundell
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Christopher discovers a hidden archipelago of islands where mythical creatures still roam free. When he meets Mal, a girl fleeing dark forces with a flying coat as her only possession, the two are pulled into a quest to save the last of the world's magic from a growing darkness.

title: Infinity Alchemist
author: Kacen Callender
synopsis: Ash Woods isn't supposed to practice alchemy -- only the elite are legally permitted. When he's caught secretly studying by Ramsay Thorne, Ramsay offers a deal instead of turning him in: help find the legendary Book of Source in exchange for lessons. As Ash and Ramsay's feelings for each other grow, their quest pits them against powerful alchemists, including Ash's own estranged father.

title: One Piece Novel: Law
author: Eiichiro Oda (original), Kaita Mizuno
synopsis: A prose novel exploring the backstory of Trafalgar Law, tracing his tragic childhood, his connection to Corazon of the Donquixote Pirates, and the events that shaped him into the pirate later known as the 'Surgeon of Death.'

title: Scarlet Morning
author: ND Stevenson
synopsis: Orphans Viola and Wilmur have waited fifteen years for their parents in the colorless town of Caveat. When pirate captain Cadence Chase breaks down their door one stormy night, they strike a deal: she can take their most prized possession -- a mysterious book -- if she takes them too. Their voyage into the world beyond Caveat leads them toward the truth behind an old legend and the key to saving Dickerson's Sea from ruin.

title: The Aftermyth
author: Tracy Wolff
synopsis: Penelope Weaver has trained her whole life to attend Anaximander's Academy, where students bring Greek myths to life and discover which god's principles they embody -- Penelope is sure she's an Athena. But when she and her twin brother Paris arrive at school, fate has very different plans for her, in this dark academia fantasy series opener.

title: The Boy, the Mountain, and the Serpent Who Ate the Moon
author: Caris Avendano Cruz
synopsis: In the Filipino town of Santo Cristo, known for its lively fiesta and the many people who have mysteriously disappeared, three kids -- Bayani, Isay, and Aaron -- cross a mysterious bridge into a forgotten island of myth, where they must face monsters and cryptids from Filipino folklore to find their way home.

title: The Claiming (The Last Resort, Book 2)
author: Jasmine Warga
synopsis: Teddy is finally excited for school with his new friends Lila and Caleb by his side -- but strange things keep happening at the Castle Hill Inn even after they defeated the Fire Maiden. When Lila starts flickering in and out, seemingly being pulled into the land of the dead, Teddy must face his greatest fears to save her.

title: The Nowhere Beast (Labyrinth of Souls, Book 2)
author: Leslie Vedder
synopsis: Returning to Candle Corps Academy as a second-year Spark, Ix Tatterfall must face the Nowhere Beast, a mysterious creature made of pure darkness that threatens everything she holds dear. When ghosts of Candle Corps past rise from the catacombs, Ix and her friends must take part in an ancient ritual to reinforce the seals protecting their world from the Labyrinth's deadliest Nightmares.

title: The Raven Boys
author: Maggie Stiefvater
synopsis: Blue Sargent has grown up knowing that if she kisses her true love, he will die. She's never worried about it -- until she falls in with a group of private-school boys, the Raven Boys, obsessed with finding a dead Welsh king. As Blue is drawn into their supernatural quest, she realizes one of the boys might be the true love she's been warned about.

title: To Steal from Thieves (Thieves & Kings, Book 1)
author: M.K. Lobb
synopsis: In an alternate 1851 Victorian London where alchemologists craft magic, orphaned Zaria Mendoza struggles to keep her father's dark-market business alive. When charming con man Kane Durante coerces her into helping him steal a priceless necklace from the Great Exhibition, the two reluctant allies must pull off an impossible heist -- while fighting their growing feelings for each other.

title: You Are Now Old Enough to Hear This
author: Aaron Starmer
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Roman Barnes has never heard the full story of the Toe Beast, a family legend his grandpa invented to explain his missing toe. After his grandpa dies, Roman clears out his house and finds strange objects -- a jar of formaldehyde, a mysterious handwritten book, a rusty bucket with odd powers -- that unravel extraordinary, magical secrets from his family's past.

title: Buckle Up (A Graphic Novel)
author: Lawrence Lindell
synopsis: Lonnie is adjusting to life after his parents' divorce. He lives with his mom and sister but misses his dad, so his father makes the most of their car rides together -- using the drives to talk through the big, hard subjects, one trip at a time.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 1 (Vol. 1-3)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Short but determined Shoyo Hinata is inspired by a nationally televised volleyball match to join his middle school volleyball club. After a crushing defeat by 'the King of the Court,' Tobio Kageyama, Hinata vows revenge -- only to end up as teammates with his rival on the Karasuno High School volleyball team.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 2 (Vol. 4-6)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Karasuno High's volleyball team, led by the odd-couple duo of Hinata and Kageyama, trains hard and battles rival schools as they fight to reclaim Karasuno's former glory on the court.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 3 (Vol. 7-9)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Karasuno faces off against powerhouse teams in intense inter-high tournament matches, testing the growing bond and teamwork between Hinata, Kageyama, and their teammates.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 4 (Vol. 10-12)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: As the tournament continues, Karasuno battles Date Tech's formidable 'iron wall' defense, pushing the team to develop new strategies and quick attacks to break through.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 5 (Vol. 13-15)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Karasuno's rivalry with powerhouse Aoba Johsai intensifies as both teams fight for a spot in the finals, showcasing fierce competition and personal growth among the players.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 6 (Vol. 16-18)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Karasuno faces Shiratorizawa Academy, the reigning champions, in a high-stakes match that pushes Hinata and his teammates to their absolute limits.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 7 (Vol. 19-21)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: The team's hard-fought battles continue as new rivals and challenges emerge, with Karasuno striving to prove themselves on the national stage.

title: Haikyu!! Omnibus 8 (Vol. 22-24)
author: Haruichi Furudate
synopsis: Karasuno's journey continues with fierce matches that test both individual skill and team unity as they chase their dream of reaching the top.

title: Kaiju No. 8, Vol. 1
author: Naoya Matsumoto
synopsis: Kafka Hibino dreams of joining the Japan Defense Force to fight kaiju, but works as a cleanup man instead. When a mysterious creature grants him the power to transform into a kaiju himself, he must hide his new identity while his childhood friend rises through the ranks of the very force meant to destroy monsters like him.

title: Kaiju No. 8, Vol. 2
author: Naoya Matsumoto
synopsis: Now able to transform into a powerful kaiju, Kafka must keep his secret from his new Defense Force unit while fighting to protect the people of Japan from monstrous threats.

title: Kaiju No. 8, Vol. 3
author: Naoya Matsumoto
synopsis: Kafka continues to train with the Defense Force, hiding his kaiju powers as new threats -- and suspicions about his true identity -- begin to surface.

title: Medalist 1
author: Tsurumaikada
synopsis: Inori is an 11-year-old girl who dreams of becoming a figure skater, but everyone around her -- including her own mother -- thinks she's too old to start and doubts she has what it takes. When she meets Tsukasa, a coach whose own competitive dreams were crushed, the unlikely pair form a partnership built on hard work and belief in each other, aiming for the world stage.

title: Medalist 2
author: Tsurumaikada
synopsis: Inori and her coach Tsukasa continue their journey in competitive figure skating, facing new rivals, difficult training, and the pressure of proving themselves in official competition.

title: Medalist 3
author: Tsurumaikada
synopsis: As Inori's skills grow, she and Tsukasa face tougher competition and higher stakes, testing their resolve to reach the top of the figure skating world.

title: Minecraft: The Manga, Vol. 1
author: Kazuyoshi Seto
synopsis: Ten-year-old Nico White, son of a renowned adventurer, is bored with peaceful village life and dreams of exploring the wider Minecraft world. When zombies attack, he gets his chance to prove himself -- and sets off on an adventure toward the end of the world.

title: Minecraft: The Manga, Vol. 2
author: Kazuyoshi Seto
synopsis: Nico White continues his journey through the blocky world of Minecraft, crafting new tools and facing fresh dangers as he pushes further from home.

title: Minecraft: The Manga, Vol. 3
author: Kazuyoshi Seto
synopsis: Nico's adventures continue as he explores new biomes and creatures, growing stronger and closer to uncovering the mysteries of his world.

title: Minecraft: The Manga, Vol. 4
author: Kazuyoshi Seto
synopsis: Nico faces new challenges and enemies as his quest to reach the end of the Minecraft world continues.

title: Ms. Marvel: Remnants of the Past
author: Saadia Faruqi
synopsis: Kamala Khan is a teenager balancing family life with her secret identity as Jersey City's superhero Ms. Marvel. When she accidentally comes into possession of an ancient magical artifact, she's pulled into a mystery that takes her from Jersey City to Lahore, Pakistan, as she races to keep the treasure out of the Kingpin's greedy hands.

title: Speechless: A Graphic Novel
author: Aron Nels Steinke
synopsis: Mira hopes middle school will be a fresh start, but she struggles to speak in class even though she talks freely at home. Her only outlet is a secret stop-motion animation channel -- until her former best friend turned rival, Chloe, ends up moving in with her family.

title: Sugar Shack (Peapod Farm #3)
author: Lucy Knisley
synopsis: Jen has finally settled into her blended family on Peapod Farm, especially after her stepsister Reese calls her 'sister.' But a rift forms with stepsister Andy, who insists she's Reese's only real sister, leaving Jen to navigate a cold winter and figure out what family really means.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 1
author: Osamu Nishi
synopsis: Hopeless pushover Iruma Suzuki's trashy parents sell off his soul, and he must now live and attend school in the Netherworld. With help from his unique survival skills and his doting demon grandfather, Iruma tries to make it through -- all while hiding that he's secretly human.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 2
author: Osamu Nishi
synopsis: Iruma's dumb luck and good nature have made him the talk of Babyls, catching the attention of student council president Ameri, who suspects he isn't the demon everyone thinks he is.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 3
author: Osamu Nishi
synopsis: Having reached his first personal goal, Iruma searches for a demonic club (a 'battler') where he truly belongs, crashing into a rare demon without magic along the way.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun 4
author: Osamu Nishi
synopsis: The long-awaited Battler Party arrives at Babyls, but when a surprise threatens to upend the festivities, Iruma and his friends must find the culprit before time runs out.

title: Wicked: The Graphic Novel, Part I
author: Gregory Maguire (adapt.), Scott Hampton
synopsis: A full-color graphic novel adaptation of Gregory Maguire's novel Wicked. Elphaba, born with emerald-green skin in the mean and superstitious land of Oz, grows up facing prejudice and hardship, setting the stage for her journey toward becoming the witch the world would come to fear.

title: Winging It: A Graphic Novel
author: Megan Wagner Lloyd
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Luna never wanted to move from California to Virginia with her dad, or live with the formal grandmother she barely knows. But after spotting the rare luna moth she was named for at a museum, she sets out to see one in the wild, using her late mother's naturalist notebooks -- a journey that helps her make a friend, feel at home, and understand the mother she never got to know.

title: 39 Clues Book 1: The Maze of Bones
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: Orphaned siblings Amy and Dan Cahill learn at their grandmother Grace's funeral that their family is the most powerful in history. Grace's will offers heirs a choice: one million dollars, or the first of 39 clues in a global treasure hunt for a secret that grants immense power. Amy and Dan set off on a race across the world, competing against ruthless relatives to find the clues first.

title: 39 Clues Book 2: One False Note
author: Gordon Korman
synopsis: Amy and Dan Cahill travel to Vienna following a clue hidden in a piece of Mozart sheet music. As they uncover secrets about Mozart's overlooked sister Nannerl, they must stay a step ahead of ruthless relatives who will do anything to win the family's treasure hunt.

title: 39 Clues Book 3: The Sword Thief
author: Peter Lerangis
synopsis: Amy and Dan team up with their unpredictable Uncle Alistair Oh and travel to Japan and Korea, tracking the legacy of legendary warrior Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Chased by yakuza and their own scheming relatives, the siblings must decide who they can trust as the clue hunt turns increasingly dangerous.

title: A Deadly Inheritance
author: Kelley Armstrong
synopsis: After her mother's death, seventeen-year-old Liliana discovers she's heir to a billion-dollar corporation and is sent to Westdale Academy, the elite boarding school her estranged mother once fled. As Lili investigates the mysterious deaths of past students, she uncovers dark secrets connecting the school's past to her own family's fortune.

title: Apartment 713
author: Kevin Sylvester
synopsis: Jake Simmons hates his new home, the Regency, a rundown building full of peeling wallpaper -- until it reveals its mysteries. When the city plans to demolish it, Jake is summoned to the off-limits apartment 713, and opening the door sends him traveling into the past, where he and new friend Beth search for clues to save the building.

title: Bad in the Blood
author: Matteo L. Cerilli
synopsis: In the 1920s-inspired city of Puck's Port, a violent murder at the docks ignites distrust between humans and fey. Gristle, forced into his late father's role as private investigator, teams up with his fey sister Hawthorne -- who has her own uncontrollable magical power -- to solve the case in this noir-tinged queer fantasy.

title: City Spies, Book 7: Europa
author: James Ponti
synopsis: With their nemesis Le Fantome behind bars, the City Spies are ready for a fresh start -- until the imprisoned villain Umbra threatens to attack targets across Europe unless he's released. Splitting up across Rome, Paris, London, and Amsterdam, the young MI6 spy team races to solve codes and stop the attacks.

title: Dial If You Dare (Orca Shivers 5)
author: Alexandre Cote-Fournier
synopsis: On Halloween, Alex tells his cousins the legend of Jack Hatchett, a hardware store owner rumored to be a serial killer whose store burned down before police could prove anything. Legend says his ghost still answers if you dial his old store's number -- and Alex, Chloe, and Luke can't resist finding out if it's true.

title: Do Not Go Out at Night (Orca Shivers 8)
author: Francois Gravel, Martine Latulippe
synopsis: Oliver and Maddy sneak into a construction site at night and discover a half-buried backpack with strange contents before being chased off by a man and his dog. Told through journal entries, transcripts, and news clippings, this fast-paced thriller follows the pair as they realize they've uncovered evidence of a murderer's long-hidden crime.

title: Games Untold
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: A companion collection to The Inheritance Games series, gathering novellas and bonus stories -- including Hannah's side of The Same Backward as Forward -- that expand the world of Hawthorne House and its puzzle-loving cast.

title: Opal Watson: A Case Most Fowl
author: Brittany J. Thurman
synopsis: When her schoolmate's pet bird Blizzard goes missing, super sleuth Opal Watson teams up with Frank and Piper's reformed-bully brother Jake to track it down. Meanwhile, Opal keeps digging into her own family mystery -- who was Maude Watson, the woman in an old newspaper photo -- leading her through Chicago's cemeteries and abandoned tunnels.

title: Snoop
author: Gordon Korman
synopsis: Stuck at home for weeks with two broken legs after a skiing accident, Carter gets bored and starts watching live feeds from police cams around town. He soon becomes obsessed with spying on classmates and neighbors -- until he notices something very strange going on, and the people he's watching realize he's watching them.

title: The Case of the Scarlet Snakebite
author: Christyne Morrell
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Agatha Christie superfan Amber Adler is convinced a crime is brewing when the wealthy Willoughby family checks into her mother's bed-and-breakfast. When a priceless ruby called the Scarlet Snakebite is stolen and her mother is framed, Amber must use her sleuthing skills to catch the real thief and clear her mom's name.

title: The Inheritance Games
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: Avery Grambs is a high school senior barely scraping by when she learns that eccentric billionaire Tobias Hawthorne, a total stranger, has died and left her almost his entire fortune. To inherit, she must move into Hawthorne House and live alongside the four grandsons who had everything taken from them -- and figure out why a dying man chose her.

title: The Ruling Class (The Fixer, Book 1)
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: Tess Kendrick is sent from her grandfather's Montana ranch to live with her estranged older sister Ivy in Washington, D.C. -- only to discover Ivy is the capital's go-to 'fixer' who makes powerful people's scandals disappear. Enrolled at an elite school, Tess is pulled into fixing problems for the D.C. elite herself, as secrets from both sisters' double lives collide in a deadly political scandal.

title: The Squad: Killer Spirit
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: The sequel to The Squad: Perfect Cover, following Toby Klein as she continues her double life as both a cheerleader and a secret government operative, tackling a new dangerous mission alongside her fellow spy-cheerleaders.

title: The Squad: Perfect Cover
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: When computer hacker and karate black belt Toby Klein transfers to Bayport High, cheerleading is the last thing on her mind. But a mysterious note pushes her to audition for the school's elite cheer squad -- which turns out to be a front for a team of highly trained teenage government operatives.

title: 100% Unofficial Fortnite
author: Egmont Publishing
synopsis: An unofficial, fact-packed guide for Fortnite fans, filled with tips, trivia, character and weapon rundowns, and behind-the-scenes facts about the hit battle royale game.

title: A World Without Summer
author: Nicholas Day
synopsis: The true story of the 1815 Tambora volcanic eruption, which plunged the world into darkness and disrupted the global climate -- and, during that dark, cold, rainy summer on Lake Geneva, inspired young Mary Shelley to write Frankenstein.

title: Abolition and the African American Story
author: Patricia Williams Dockery
synopsis: Part of the Race to the Truth series, this nonfiction book tells the true story of the Civil War and Reconstruction from the African American perspective -- the vast network of abolitionists, soldiers, and public speakers who kept fighting for freedom long after the war ended.

title: Arm in Arm: The Grimke Sisters' Fight for Abolition and Women's Rights
author: Angelica Shirley Carpenter
synopsis: A nonfiction biography of Sarah and Angelina Grimke, sisters born into a wealthy enslaving family in Charleston who rejected slavery, became Quakers and abolitionists, and went on to become among the first women to speak publicly in the United States -- for both abolition and women's rights.

title: Basket Ball: The Story of the All-American Game
author: Kadir Nelson
synopsis: A beautifully illustrated nonfiction history of basketball, narrated in the voice of an elder player tracing the sport from its 1891 origins to today's fast-paced game, with profiles of legends like Wilt Chamberlain, Magic Johnson, Michael Jordan, LeBron James, and Stephen Curry.

title: Black History Is Your History
author: Taylor Cassidy
synopsis: TikTok's 'Fast Black History' creator Taylor Cassidy blends nonfiction and memoir to introduce twelve trailblazing figures from Black history -- activists, literary giants, Olympic medalists, and more -- weaving in her own funny, relatable personal stories and life lessons along the way.

title: Every Day Amazing
author: Mike Barfield
synopsis: A fun nonfiction compendium offering a fascinating fact for every date on the calendar -- from Buzz Aldrin's first space selfie to International Day of the Nacho -- perfect for reading daily throughout the year or looking up what happened on any given day.

title: Feeling Your Feelings: The Head-to-Toe Science of Emotions
author: Tanya Lloyd Kyi
synopsis: A nonfiction, toe-to-head tour through the human body exploring how and why we experience emotions -- from butterflies in the stomach to blushing cheeks -- blending science, history, and cultural studies to help young readers understand and self-regulate their feelings.

title: Friedel and Gina
author: Jeremy Dronfield
synopsis: The true story of Jewish twin sisters Friedel and Gina Rosenthal, who were nine when the Nazis rose to power in Germany. Deported to a ghetto in Poland and later to concentration camps, the twins relied on their unbreakable bond to survive the atrocities of the Holocaust together.

title: Great Escapes
author: David Long
synopsis: Over thirty true tales of daring escapes, from enslaved people fleeing captivity and wartime heroes smuggled across occupied Europe to famous prison breaks -- including Harriet Tubman's journey to freedom and Henry 'Box' Brown, who posted himself to freedom in a crate -- illustrated in full color comic-book style.

title: Guinness World Records 2026
author: Guinness World Records
synopsis: The latest edition of the bestselling annual, packed with thousands of astonishing record-breaking facts, feats, and achievements from around the world, illustrated with photos and infographics.

title: How to Survive an Apocalypse
author: Coby Coonradt, Cameron Hardy
synopsis: A fun, illustrated nonfiction guide from the hosts of The Casual Preppers podcast, covering prepping basics like first aid, water purification, and emergency kits, then walking readers through surviving all kinds of imagined disasters -- zombie outbreaks, alien invasions, and more.

title: Shirley: An Indian Residential School Story
author: Joanne Robertson, with Shirley (Fletcher) Horn
synopsis: A true story of resilience: Shirley Fletcher Horn was only five when she was taken from her family to live at Shingwauk Indian Residential School. Separated from her siblings and facing hardship, Shirley kept going -- making friends, finding small joys, and looking ahead to summers when she could return home.

title: The Book of Weird Mysteries
author: John Hawkins
synopsis: An illustrated nonfiction collection of 60 unexplained and eerie phenomena, from the Bermuda Triangle and the Roswell Incident to the Loch Ness Monster and crop circles, examining the evidence and mystery behind each strange story.

title: The Mona Lisa Vanishes
author: Nicholas Day
synopsis: The true story of how the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre in 1911 and became the most famous painting in the world. Told like a witty thriller, this narrative nonfiction traces the painting's origins in Renaissance Florence and the sensational theft and investigation that turned it into a global icon.

title: To Infinity and Beyond: A Journey of Cosmic Discovery
author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Lindsey Nyx Walker
synopsis: An illustrated nonfiction journey through space and time, from the Big Bang to the farthest reaches of the universe, as astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson explains black holes, parallel worlds, time travel, and more -- with a nod to Hollywood's science triumphs and bloopers along the way.

title: Ultimate Smart Girl's Guide to Being Your Best
author: Aubre Andrus and others
synopsis: An all-in-one American Girl advice guide for tweens, gathering expert tips and excerpts from the bestselling Smart Girl's Guide series on self-esteem, friends, family, sports, money, and navigating middle school.

title: Aarzu All Around
author: Marzieh Abbas
synopsis: Recently orphaned twelve-year-old Aarzu lives with her strict uncle in Karachi, Pakistan, where she's forbidden from playing cricket like the boys. When her little sister needs urgent medical treatment, Aarzu disguises herself as a boy to get a job and earn money -- all while secretly practicing cricket and trying not to get caught.

title: Call Your Boyfriend
author: Olivia A. Cole, Ashley Woodfolk
synopsis: Beau has been secretly hooking up with popular Maia Moon, while Charm has been falling for her during tutoring sessions. When Maia kisses Charm, then accepts a promposal from her boyfriend days later, both Beau and Charm are left heartbroken -- so they team up to get revenge, only to find themselves falling for each other instead.

title: Gone Viral
author: Gary Soto
synopsis: Seventh-graders Jason and Sean start a joke musical act performing 'non-songs' inspired by a silent composition -- and when a video of their first concert goes viral, they become unlikely international rock stars, popularizing mindfulness across the globe with the help of a talking cockatiel and a kid talent agent.

title: Here for a Good Time
author: Kim Spencer
synopsis: It's 1990, and Morgan has grown up in the small fishing town of Prince Rupert, BC, watching over her hard-partying commercial fisherman dad since her mom left. After enrolling in an alternative school, she meets Nate, who opens her world -- and becomes a lifeline when tragedy strikes and Morgan uncovers painful truths about her mother's past and its intergenerational effects.

title: Julia and Romano
author: Eric Walters
synopsis: After a difficult divorce, sixteen-year-old Jules moves from Toronto to small-town Campbell River, BC, where she meets and connects with Cody Romano. But things get complicated when they discover their parents are on opposite sides of a contentious court case -- Cody's father owns the lumber mill that Jules's mother's environmental organization is trying to stop from logging.

title: Just Another Epic Love Poem
author: Parisa Akhbari
synopsis: Mitra and her best friend Bea have spent five years filling a shared notebook with the stanzas of a never-ending poem, pouring out everything from Mitra's feelings about her absent mother to Bea's breakups. But one thing threatens to change their friendship forever: Mitra is quietly, hopelessly in love with Bea.

title: Love Me Tomorrow
author: Emiko Jean
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Emma doesn't believe in love after her parents' bitter divorce -- until she starts receiving notes from someone claiming to be her greatest love, writing to her from the future. As Emma races to figure out which of the boys in her life is writing the letters, she discovers love might be more real than she ever let herself believe.

title: Magnitude
author: Jennifer A. Nielsen
synopsis: San Francisco, 1906: when the Great Earthquake strikes, Cora is trapped underground with Chi, a girl she just met, before their new friend Oliver pulls them from the rubble. Together the three must search the decimated city for their families while evading fires and a gang of thieves after a secret Cora holds.

title: Nadia Islam, on the Record
author: Adiba Jaigirdar
synopsis: Eight-year-old Nadia is disappointed to spend her first Ramadan fast in Bangladesh instead of with her best friend Yasmin -- until her journalist aunt's reporting on the region's climate-driven flooding gives Nadia the story she needs to become editor-in-chief of her school paper.

title: Sam
author: Eric Walters
synopsis: Redheaded orphan Sam can't seem to stay out of trouble, and his latest fight lands him in a juvenile detention center awaiting trial. Given a reading assignment there, Sam expects nothing from a classic book about another redheaded orphan -- but finds a kindred spirit in Anne of Green Gables and an unexpected source of hope, in this modern homage to the L.M. Montgomery classic.

title: Some of Us Are Brave
author: Saadia Faruqi
synopsis: It's a humid summer in Houston, and Yasir, Mona, and Cody could hardly be called friends. But when Hurricane Harvey hits and rising floodwaters pull their lives together, the three very different kids must work as a team to survive -- a storm that churns up their deepest fears and cements a bond between them.

title: The Catastrophic Friendship Fails of Lottie Brooks
author: Katie Kirby
synopsis: In the second diary-style installment of the bestselling series, 11-year-old Lottie Brooks navigates her first year of middle school -- new baby sister, reuniting best friends, and auditioning for the school play -- while facing all the usual friendship fails and embarrassing mishaps of growing up.

title: The Freedom Seeker
author: Ruchira Gupta
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Simi Singh's happy life in Northern India is upended when her family becomes entangled in the realities of migration and political asylum. Told through a child's eyes, this novel follows Simi's daring journey of displacement to the United States and her relentless fight to reunite her family.

title: The Road From Nowhere
author: Avi
synopsis: In 1893, in the isolated silver-mining camp of Gatchett's Gulch, Colorado, thirteen-year-old Ollie dreams of striking it rich to give his family a better life -- despite not being able to read and despite the mine owner who illegally controls all the silver. When Ollie, his brother Gus, and their friend Alys discover a silver-rich cave, they must find a way to claim it for themselves.

title: The Same Backward as Forward
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
synopsis: A flip-book novel telling the tragic, star-crossed love story of Hannah Rooney and Tobias Hawthorne II -- the lost scion of Hawthorne House -- readable from either direction. Hannah, determined to escape her criminal family, ends up saving Toby's life after he's pulled from the ocean with no memory of who he is, setting off a romance that was never supposed to happen.

title: The Teacher of Nomad Land: A World War II Story
author: Daniel Nayeri
synopsis: In 1941 Iran, occupied by British and Soviet forces during WWII, newly orphaned siblings Babak and Sana set off across the Zagros Mountains, with Babak taking up his late father's job teaching nomadic tribes. Along the way they meet Ben, a Jewish boy hiding from a Nazi spy, and the three are pulled into a race for survival, National Book Award winner.

title: Track, Book 5: Coach
author: Jason Reynolds
synopsis: Before he was the coach guiding Ghost, Lu, Patina, and Sunny, he was Otie Brody, a boy obsessed with sprinting like his hero Carl Lewis and facing upheaval at home in the 1980s. This companion to Jason Reynolds's bestselling Track series traces the making of the man who would one day become Coach.

title: Ungifted, Book 3: Hypergifted
author: Gordon Korman
synopsis: Twelve-year-old super-genius Noah Youkilis gets into prestigious Wilderton University straight out of eighth grade, and brings his best friend Donovan -- the ordinary kid who barely made it through eighth grade -- along for the summer. As Noah tries to fit in by joining a secret campus society, the pair discover what it really means to be smart, in this sequel to Ungifted and Supergifted.

title: Best of All Worlds
author: Kenneth Oppel
synopsis: Xavier wakes up during a family weekend at the cabin to find it's been mysteriously transported somewhere else entirely -- he, his dad, and pregnant stepmom are trapped inside an invisible dome with no captors in sight. Three years later, another family arrives with very different ideas about their situation, leading to escalating tension in this genre-defying dystopian thriller.

title: Fearless (The Powerless Trilogy, Book 3)
author: Lauren Roberts
synopsis: The explosive conclusion to the Powerless trilogy, as Paedyn and Kai face the full consequences of the kingdom's divide between Elites and Ordinaries in a fight for freedom and each other.

title: MindWorks: An Uncanny Compendium of Short Fiction
author: Neal Shusterman
synopsis: A collection of 43 uncanny short stories spanning sci-fi, horror, and the fantastical -- from a world where bats block out the sun to soup that traps souls -- compiled from Shusterman's classic and brand-new tales, including two stories from the world of Scythe.

title: Powerless (The Powerless Trilogy, Book 1)
author: Lauren Roberts
synopsis: In the kingdom of Ilya, only Elites -- those gifted with powers by a past plague -- are allowed to live freely; Ordinaries like Paedyn Gray are hunted. Posing as an Elite to survive as a thief, Paedyn finds her secret and her heart entangled with Kai, the prince whose job is to hunt Ordinaries like her.

title: Reckless (The Powerless Trilogy, Book 2)
author: Lauren Roberts
synopsis: The gripping sequel to Powerless, continuing Paedyn and Kai's forbidden romance as the truth about Ilya's Elites and Ordinaries -- and the dangerous secrets both are keeping -- comes further into the open.
